independent_wording sl: Most lines are close translations of the example: the hook ('Tokrat začnemo kar ostro...'), the Mega Knight and trophies defence, 'tri dni ga ni bilo', 'Iskreno, sploh ni slabo', 'Ne vem, kako vas sploh še držijo v teh šolah. Mene bi že trikrat vrgli ven, pa jaz samo klepetam', 'naj vsaj počakajo do govorilnih ur', the mother's 'zardevati' line, and kuhalnica for kajšen. Mostly the brand was swapped.

features_claims sl: The practice test is described as 'kjer izberem poglavja, ki jih hočem ponoviti' (where I pick the chapters I want to review). This chapter selection is carried over from Astra's practice exams ('dobijem sve lekcije, izaberem koje želim'), and it is not a listed Memo AI feature. Replace it with the practice test generating questions from your own material.
